name: 큰물주머니

name: 특대물주머니
descriptionEn: A monster organ designed to hold and preserve tremendous amounts of water.

name: 켈비 뿔

name: 양질의 모피
descriptionEn: A pelt from a small animal. Used for many things, but mostly just regular clothes.

name: 극상의 모피
descriptionEn: A pelt from a small animal. Used for many things, but mostly just regular clothes.

name: 재기 가죽

name: 몬스터의 농즙
descriptionEn: A broth made from only the thickest of a monster's juices. Quite rich.

name: 몬스터의 특농즙
descriptionEn: A broth made from only the thickest, choicest parts of a monster's juices. Gross?

name: 흑진주
descriptionEn: The Hunting Fleet sometimes brings these back. The black glow fetches a high price.

name: 자화룡 비늘
descriptionEn: A scale from a flying wyvern native to this area. Rathian mate with male Rathalos.

name: 자화룡 비늘+
descriptionEn: A fine Rathian scale. It may not look special, but its hardness puts other scales to shame.

name: 자화룡 두툼비늘
descriptionEn: A particularly thick Rathian scale. Its large size proves its owner's advanced age.

name: 자화룡 갑각
descriptionEn: A shell piece comprised of layered scales, making it much harder than just one.

name: 자화룡 견갑각
descriptionEn: A sturdy Rathian carapace. Even harder than a normal Rathian shell.

name: 자화룡 중갑각
descriptionEn: A Rathian shell heavier than a carapace. Used to reinforce parts of equipment.

name: 자화룡 익막
descriptionEn: Hard to forge with, but its thermal properties make it ideal for armor lining.

name: 자화룡 가시
descriptionEn: Needle-like hair found on the Rathian's back and wings. They contain poison.

name: 자화룡 가시+
descriptionEn: As sharp as the keenest blade. It is longer and sturdier than other spikes.

name: 자화룡 비밀가시
descriptionEn: Only a few of those superior spikes grow on a Rathian. It is both sharp and highly toxic.

name: 자화룡 역린
descriptionEn: A searing tail scale. Hard to come by and as fiery as the wyvern it came from.

name: 자화룡 홍옥
descriptionEn: A rare gem formed inside a Rathian. It seems almost too nice to forge with.

name: 자화룡 천린
descriptionEn: A legendary Rathian scale. Those who craft it are said to rule the earth and seize the sky.

name: 홍화룡 비늘+
descriptionEn: A high-grade scale from a Pink Rathian. Chic hunters love the blend of strength and style.

name: 홍화룡 두툼비늘
descriptionEn: A thick, shiny scale from a Pink Rathian. Rare is the artisan who has ever laid eyes on one.

name: 홍화룡 중갑각
descriptionEn: A hevy Pink Rathian cortex made up of a single beautiful plate. It commands top zenny when sold.

name: 금화룡 두툼비늘
descriptionEn: A thick Gold Rathian scale unlike anything seen before. Sunlight gives it an almost sacred glow.

name: 금화룡 중갑각
descriptionEn: A cortex carved from a Gold Rathian. All who see it gasp at its intense glow.

name: 금화룡 비밀가시
descriptionEn: A poisonous spike found on Gold Rathians in rare circumstances. It can pierce through anything.

name: 화룡 비늘
descriptionEn: A Rathalos scale. Wyvern scales like this one and the harder shells are basic forging items.

name: 화룡 비늘+
descriptionEn: An extraordinarily durable scale carved from the body of a Rathalos.

name: 화룡 두툼비늘
descriptionEn: A Rathalos part made of several overlapping scales. Its strength is a natural wonder.

name: 화룡 갑각
descriptionEn: A shell piece comprised of layered scales, making it much harder than just one.

name: 화룡 견갑각
descriptionEn: A rigid Rathalos carapace. Even harder than a normal Rathalos Shell.

name: 화룡 중갑각
descriptionEn: A robust Rathalos shell that is harder and sturdier than a carapace.

name: 화룡 익막
descriptionEn: Hard to forge with, but its thermal properties make it ideal for armor lining.

name: 화룡 날개
descriptionEn: A wing that has been removed. Skilled artisans can craft it into strong equipment.

name: 화룡 강날개
descriptionEn: A top-grade Rathalos wing, removed in full. Such majesty befits the King of the Skies.

name: 화룡 꼬리
descriptionEn: The severed tail of a Rathalos. It has any number of uses.

name: 화룡 질긴꼬리
descriptionEn: A top-grade Rathalos tail. Strong ones like this are precious, and only used in select equipment.

name: 화룡 역린
descriptionEn: A searing tail scale. Hard to come by and as fiery as the wyvern it came from.

name: 화룡 홍옥
descriptionEn: A rare gem formed inside a Rathalos. It seems almost too nice to forge with.

name: 화룡 천린
descriptionEn: A legendary Rathalos scale. Those who craft it are said to rule the earth and seize the sky.

name: 창화룡 두툼비늘
descriptionEn: An Azure Rathalos part made of several overlapping scales. It boasts beauty and strength.

name: 창화룡 꼬리
descriptionEn: The severed tail of an Azure Rathalos. It fetches a high price due to its rarity.

name: 창화룡 질긴꼬리
descriptionEn: A top-grade Azure Rathalos tail. Strong ones like this are prized by all and sold at high prices.

name: 창화룡 날개
descriptionEn: A wing that has been removed. Excellent for forging both weapons and armor.

name: 은화룡 두툼비늘
descriptionEn: A Silver Rathalos part made of several overlapping scales. Makes for a nice silver accessory.

name: 은화룡 중갑각
descriptionEn: A heavy Silver Rathalos cortex. This legendary item shines like moonlight, even in darkness.

name: 화룡 골수
descriptionEn: Recent advances allow this marrow to be extracted. It ignites on air contact.

name: 화룡 연수
descriptionEn: Recent advances allow this red hot organ to be removed, but it's hard to forge with.

name: 각룡 중갑각
descriptionEn: The rigid cortex of a Diablos, both harder and sturdier than its carapace.

name: 각룡 중갑
descriptionEn: Tough Diablos backplate, strengthened by burning sands. An ideal material for armor.

name: 대지를 뚫는 강뿔
descriptionEn: An especially elegant Diablos horn with almost perfect shape. An extremely rare material.

name: 흑각룡 중갑각
descriptionEn: A heavy Black Diablos cortex. Its weight reveals its overwhelming density and strength.

name: 흑각룡 중갑
descriptionEn: Finely honed Black Diablos backplate. Best described as black, hard, and heavy.

name: 뇌랑룡 견갑각
descriptionEn: The teal carapace of a Zinogre. Its magnificence reveals the futility of facing the monarch.

name: 뇌랑룡 중갑각
descriptionEn: The teal cortex of a Zinogre. The monarch's armor crushes wills with its immense power.

name: 뇌랑룡 첨예뿔
descriptionEn: A pointed Zinogre horn. When carved, it can be used to grant equipment incomparable power.

name: 뇌랑룡 강뿔
descriptionEn: A mighty Zinogre horn. None can sand before its sky-shattering, awe-inspiring power.

name: 뇌랑룡 첨예발톱
descriptionEn: A sharp, high voltage Zinogre claw. Its electrified attacks are truly brutal.

name: 뇌랑룡 꼬리
descriptionEn: The plate-covered tail of a Zinogre. It wields deadly force when swung.

name: 뇌랑룡 질긴꼬리
descriptionEn: A superior Zinogre tail that wields incomparable destructive power.

name: 뇌랑룡 전기갑각+
descriptionEn: A Zinogre shell that stores and releases electricity. Grants a thunder god's power to gear.

name: 뇌랑룡 벽옥
descriptionEn: A rare gem occasionally produced inside a Zinogre's body. The monarch's power swells within.

name: 옥랑룡 질긴꼬리
descriptionEn: A Stygian Zinogre's terrifyingly strong tail. Said to be able to slice through solid steel.

name: 쇄룡 견갑각
descriptionEn: A hard Brachydios carapace. Glossy like obsidian, it adds a refined beauty to crafted gear.

name: 쇄룡 중갑각
descriptionEn: The thick cortex of a Brachydios. Its stoic beauty adds strength and dignity to equipment.

name: 쇄룡 흑요갑
descriptionEn: An obsidian Brachydios brace. Makes especially strong armor, perhaps due to the slime mold.

name: 쇄룡 견흑요갑
descriptionEn: A premium Brachydios brace. The slime coating may contain weird bacteria, so be careful.

name: 쇄룡 두갑각
descriptionEn: The large, protruding scalp of a Brachydios, covered in an explosive green substance.

name: 쇄룡 첨예두갑각
descriptionEn: A hard and sharp scalp piece from a fierce Brachydios. Even more explosive than usual.

name: 수수께끼의 점균
descriptionEn: The explosive green substance found on Brachydios monsters. Handle with extreme care.

name: 빛나는 점균
descriptionEn: Highly explosive green slime found on a fierce Brachydios. Handle with extreme care.

name: 쇄룡 강철주먹
descriptionEn: A Brachydios arm that buried countless foolhardy hunters. It's covered in green slime.

name: 쇄룡 초강철주먹
descriptionEn: The arm of an especially angry Brachydios. Strong and heavy, as if made of iron.

name: 쇄룡 천각
descriptionEn: A legendary Brachydios shell. Those who craft it are said to rule the earth and seize the sky.

name: 공폭룡 검은비늘
descriptionEn: A greenish-black Deviljho scale. It's not often sold, as rumors claim it brings it misfortune.

name: 공폭룡 두툼흑비늘
descriptionEn: A heavy, high-quality Deviljho scale. Rumored to bring bad luck, but actually an excellent material.

name: 공폭룡 검은가죽
descriptionEn: Black hide that is oddly slimy and difficult to forge with.

name: 공폭룡 갈고리발톱
descriptionEn: A dangerously sharp, hooked talon. Inexperienced crafters risk serious injury.

name: 공폭룡 강고리발톱
descriptionEn: An incredibly sharp, rigid talon. Even experienced handlers can be injured if not careful.

name: 공폭룡 두갑각
descriptionEn: Removing this part of a Deviljho's skull releases an unimaginably putrid odor.

name: 공폭룡 꼬리
descriptionEn: A masive tail resembling a fin. Some folks are out to collect these exclusively.

name: 공폭룡 중꼬리
descriptionEn: A large slab of a Deviljho's leech-like tail. Even so-called experts are shocked by it.

name: 공폭룡 타액
descriptionEn: The symbol of a Deviljho's insatiable appetite. The strong acid corrodes all it touches.

name: 새까만 피
descriptionEn: Dark black blood characteristic of a Deviljho. It feels like it could jump up and attack at any time.

name: 극악한 이빨
descriptionEn: A massive, overgrown fang that can chomp through anything. Filled with pure evil.

name: 공폭룡 보옥
descriptionEn: A precious gem said to contain a Deviljho's might. Used in shady rituals.

name: 공폭룡 멸린
descriptionEn: An unsettling scale that became warped as it absorbed the malice of the Deviljho's various prey.

name: 대지의 용옥
descriptionEn: One of the tougher materials to get from a Jhen Mohran, and that's saying something.

name: 청웅수 갑각
descriptionEn: A shell piece from an Arzuros's head or back. Bends willingly and is easy to forge.

name: 청웅수 털
descriptionEn: A pelt carved from an Arzuros. The white portion is soft, while the blue is short and taut.

name: 해면질 가죽
descriptionEn: Uncannily elastic hide that retains water quite well.

name: 극채색날개
descriptionEn: A superbly colored Qurupeo feather. Nothing less than a natural work of art.

name: 이상한 부리
descriptionEn: An oddly shaped beak. It's pleasant enough.

name: 토사룡 갑각
descriptionEn: A Barroth's shell -- more often than not covered in mud, but strong either way.

name: 토사룡 두갑각
descriptionEn: This durable part of the skull is also the hardest to remove.

name: 잠구룡 가죽
descriptionEn: Hide from a Nibelsnarf. Many are surprised by its bright colors, in contrast to the outer shell.

name: 선명한 체액
descriptionEn: A fluid which helps retain water in a Nibelsnarf and allows the beast to thrive in the desert.

name: 폭추룡 골수
descriptionEn: Hard-to-obtain bone marrow used for special crafts as well as medicinal purposes.

name: 폭추룡 내열갑각
descriptionEn: Even more heat resistant than the Shell, this is said to protect sensitive organs.

name: 미추룡 뿔
descriptionEn: The horn of a Duramboros. Wider than a man's chest；all who see it are rendered speechless.

name: 각룡 갑각
descriptionEn: This shell piece is dense, as one knock will tell you, and heavier than it looks.

name: 양질의 비틀린뿔
descriptionEn: A twisted Diablos horn in great shape. Use it to make more powerful weapons.

name: 등어룡 가죽+
descriptionEn: Fine skin from a Gobul. Said to rejuvenate the skin, and quite popular with the ladies.

name: 등어룡 가시+
descriptionEn: A high-quality barb from a Gobul. Only stroner monsters have such well-shaped spikes.

name: 호박색예리이빨
descriptionEn: Amber tusks sharpened by countless kills. They can smash through gigantic ice blocks.

name: 빙아룡 모피+
descriptionEn: A high-quality white pelt with a lovely texture. Nobles use it as a symbol of authority.

name: 해룡 전기갑각+
descriptionEn: A superior shell found only on certain Lagiacrus. Its structure permits greater electric output.

name: 염과룡 지느러미+
descriptionEn: An Agnaktor fin with an elegant dappled pattern. Aparently a popular item with collectors.

name: 대해룡 갑피
descriptionEn: Even for monster skin, this is remarkably solid. Takes time and effort to craft.

name: 휘어진 용뿔
descriptionEn: A giant horn that was formed over ages. It evinces all weight of history.

name: 신비의 발광체
descriptionEn: Who knows why this organ glows, but it seems to hold incredible power.

name: 황흑룡 역린
descriptionEn: This particular Alatreon scale grows in backwards. It is as sharp as a blade.

name: 황흑룡 익막
descriptionEn: At times this looks like a dark abyss； at others, like the coming of first light.

name: 채조 두툼비늘
descriptionEn: A strong scale concealed by vivid plumage, grown to full maturity over many years.

name: 극채색농염날개
descriptionEn: A vivid feather with an elegant luster. Qurupeco with these only live in certain regions.

name: 등어룡 두툼가죽
descriptionEn: Thick skin from a Gobul. Too rubbery for eating, but perfect for crafting equipment.

name: 등어룡 비밀가시
descriptionEn: An unusual barb from a Gobul. Only the most formidable of the breed have such precious spikes.

name: 청웅수 중갑각
descriptionEn: A superior Arzuros cortext. This highly-developed shell is a huge thorn in all hunters' sides.

name: 찬란한 체액
descriptionEn: A sparkling fluid with impressive water-retention ability. Improves performance and style.

name: 토사룡 중갑각
descriptionEn: A Barroth's cortex. Years worth of mud have hardened it beyond all measure.

name: 토사룡 중두갑각
descriptionEn: The heavy scalp of a formidable Barroth. As hard to remove as it is durable.

name: 적갑수 중갑각
descriptionEn: A heavy Volvidon cortext. Difficult to forge with, but can produce genuinely powerful gear.

name: 염과룡 중갑각
descriptionEn: The rigid cortex of an Agnaktor. Highly heat-resistant, it produces bright red items when forged.

name: 빙쇄룡 중갑각
descriptionEn: The solid, ice-covered cortex of a Jade Barroth. The frosty coating is surprisngly strong.

name: 도볼스톤
descriptionEn: A legendary gem rarely produced inside a Duramboros's body. Elegant, though gloomy.

name: 폭추룡 중갑각
descriptionEn: An especially hard Uragaan cortex. Crafting with it can be a trying task, to say the least.

name: 폭추룡 천각
descriptionEn: A legendary Uragaan shell. Those who craft it are said to rule the earth and seize the sky.

name: 신룡 천린
descriptionEn: A legendary Nargacuga scale. Those who craft it are said to rule the earth and seize the sky.

name: 해룡 두툼비늘
descriptionEn: The ultimate specimen of Lagiacrus Scale. Special skills are required to craft with it.

name: 해룡 뇌전기갑각
descriptionEn: A thick shell found on a select few Lagiacrus. It releases huge bolts of electricity.

name: 해룡 푸른천린
descriptionEn: A valuable azure scale found on select Lagiacrus. Said to greatly boost equipment performance.

name: 백해룡 뇌전기갑각
descriptionEn: A thick shell seen only rarely on Ivory Lagiacrus. It can produce a veritable rain of thunderbolts.

name: 백해룡 강뿔
descriptionEn: A fine horn from an Ivory Lagiacrus. Beloved by the rich for its flawless elegance.

name: 강추룡 중내열갑각
descriptionEn: A highly heat-resistant Steel Uragaan scute. Its rigidity makes it hard to use in forging.

name: 대해룡 비늘
descriptionEn: Almost too large to be called a scale. Not as hard as you might think.

name: 심연의 용옥
descriptionEn: One of the hardest materials to reap from a Ceadeus. Its center is a bottomless void.

name: 봉산룡 중암갑각
descriptionEn: A heavy shell piece taken from a Jhen Mohran. It surpasses even steel in strength.

name: 봉산룡 중완갑
descriptionEn: A thick, high quality brace from a Jhen Mohran. Easy craftable with the right amount of force.

name: 거룩한 용이빨
descriptionEn: A beautiful fang with a divine aura. Its shape and color best other Jhen Mohran fangs.

name: 농월의 파편
descriptionEn: The moon-like bladewing of a Lucent Nargacuga. He who crafts it controls the night.

name: 황흑룡 천린
descriptionEn: The mantle of an Alatreon is the stuff of legend, containing traces of every element within.

name: 명해룡 뇌전기갑각
descriptionEn: A thick shell from an Abyssal Lagiacrus's back. Turns the sea itself into an electrified weapon.

name: 명해룡 뇌혼
descriptionEn: An unknown Abyssal Lagiacrus organ. Rumored to be the source of the monster's electricity.

name: 연흑룡 검은비늘
descriptionEn: A fiery black scale from a Dire Miralis. Also called the burning flower" for its eerie beauty."

name: 연흑룡 작열핵
descriptionEn: A burning hot core from a Dire Miralis's hips. A magma-like substance swirls inside it.

name: 광염의 대룡옥
descriptionEn: A legendary gem expelled from the body of a Dire Miralis. It formed from crystallized magma.

name: 電 撃 Ｇチケット
수광원주
descriptionEn: An indispensible item used in Decorations.

name: 양상원주
descriptionEn: An indispensible item used in Decorations.

name: 수라원주
descriptionEn: An indispensible item used in Decorations. A shame that these are so high-end.

name: 유리원주
descriptionEn: An indispensible item used in Decorations. This one doesn't come along often.

name: 금강원주
descriptionEn: An indispensible item used in Decorations. A rare orb that houses immense power.

name: 흑굉룡 두툼비늘
descriptionEn: A thick scale from a Black Tigrex.

name: 흑굉룡 중갑각
descriptionEn: A heavy shell from a Black Tigrex.
